newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's RNA offers 168 mln shares at HK$1.01 each.
newsitem.headline: HK's RNA offers 168 mln shares at HK$1.01 each.

text.p: Tem Fat Hing Fung (Holdings) Ltd said on Monday its demerged metal operating arm, RNA Holdings Ltd, plans to offer 168 million shares at HK$1.01 per share in a Hong Kong initial public offering (IPO).
The new issue will represent 25 percent of RNA's enlarged share capital, said bullion, jewellery and property concern Tem Fat Hing Fung.
The Hong Kong IPO will run from November 19-22, with dealing in the shares expected to begin on December 2. CEF Capital Ltd is the sponsor of the issue.
RNA engages in refining, casting, assaying, wholesaling and trading of precious metals as well as related arbitrage and hedging operations.
It forecasts profit after tax but before extraordinary items of not less than HK$45 million for the year ending April 30, 1997.
Based on the issue price of HK$1.01, earnings per share are forecast at 7.9 cents, representing a price/earnings multiple of 12.8 times on a weighted average basis, Tem Fat Hing Fung said.

Of net proceeds of HK$150 million, HK$70 million will be used to cut bank borrowing, HK$15 million to improve its quality management system and HK$30 million to fund the development cost of the Gold and Jewellery Exchange Centre in Penang, Malaysia.
